html:
Implement an inner Account class starting at balance 0. For each [operation, amount], deposit adds a nonnegative amount; withdraw subtracts it only if funds suffice. Return {balance: final, accepted: list of booleans}. Operations are deposit or withdraw.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      [
        "deposit",
        12
      ],
      [
        "withdraw",
        5
      ],
      [
        "withdraw",
        10
      ]
    ]
  ],
  "expected": {
    "balance": 7,
    "accepted": [
      true,
      true,
      false
    ]
  }
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    []
  ],
  "expected": {
    "balance": 0,
    "accepted": []
  }
}
Hint

Store balance on the instance and check before subtracting.

Complexity: O(n) time and output space
